scene.label: Act 3, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. Wales. A mountainous country with a cave.
scene.location: Wales. A mountainous country with a cave.

content.text: Enter from the cave Belarius, Guiderius and Arviragus.

lines.text: A goodly day not to keep house with such
lines.plainText: A goodly day not to keep house with such

lines.text: Whose roof's as low as ours! Stoop, boys; this gate
lines.plainText: Whose roof's as low as ours Stoop boys this gate

lines.text: Instructs you how t' adore the heavens, and bows you
lines.plainText: Instructs you how t' adore the heavens and bows you

lines.text: To a morning's holy office. The gates of monarchs
lines.plainText: To a morning's holy office The gates of monarchs

lines.text: Are arch'd so high that giants may jet through
lines.plainText: Are arch'd so high that giants may jet through

lines.text: And keep their impious turbans on without
lines.plainText: And keep their impious turbans on without

lines.text: Good morrow to the sun. Hail, thou fair heaven!
lines.plainText: Good morrow to the sun Hail thou fair heaven

lines.text: We house i' th' rock, yet use thee not so hardly
lines.plainText: We house i' th' rock yet use thee not so hardly

lines.text: As prouder livers do.
lines.plainText: As prouder livers do

lines.text: Hail, heaven!
lines.plainText: Hail heaven

lines.text: Hail, heaven!
lines.plainText: Hail heaven

lines.text: Now for our mountain sport. Up to yond hill,
lines.plainText: Now for our mountain sport Up to yond hill

lines.text: Your legs are young; I'll tread these flats. Consider,
lines.plainText: Your legs are young I'll tread these flats Consider

lines.text: When you above perceive me like a crow,
lines.plainText: When you above perceive me like a crow

lines.text: That it is place which lessens and sets off;
lines.plainText: That it is place which lessens and sets off

lines.text: And you may then revolve what tales I have told you
lines.plainText: And you may then revolve what tales I have told you

lines.text: Of courts, of princes, of the tricks in war.
lines.plainText: Of courts of princes of the tricks in war

lines.text: This service is not service so being done,
lines.plainText: This service is not service so being done

lines.text: But being so allow'd. To apprehend thus
lines.plainText: But being so allow'd To apprehend thus

lines.text: Draws us a profit from all things we see,
lines.plainText: Draws us a profit from all things we see

lines.text: And often to our comfort shall we find
lines.plainText: And often to our comfort shall we find

lines.text: The sharded beetle in a safer hold
lines.plainText: The sharded beetle in a safer hold

lines.text: Than is the full-wing'd eagle. O, this life
lines.plainText: Than is the fullwing'd eagle O this life

lines.text: Is nobler than attending for a check,
lines.plainText: Is nobler than attending for a check

lines.text: Richer than doing nothing for a robe,
lines.plainText: Richer than doing nothing for a robe

lines.text: Prouder than rustling in unpaid-for silk:
lines.plainText: Prouder than rustling in unpaidfor silk

lines.text: Such gain the cap of him that makes him fine,
lines.plainText: Such gain the cap of him that makes him fine

lines.text: Yet keeps his book uncross'd. No life to ours!
lines.plainText: Yet keeps his book uncross'd No life to ours

lines.text: Out of your proof you speak. We, poor unfledg'd,
lines.plainText: Out of your proof you speak We poor unfledg'd

lines.text: Have never wing'd from view o' th' nest, nor know not
lines.plainText: Have never wing'd from view o' th' nest nor know not

lines.text: What air's from home. Haply this life is best,
lines.plainText: What air's from home Haply this life is best

lines.text: If quiet life be best; sweeter to you
lines.plainText: If quiet life be best sweeter to you

lines.text: That have a sharper known; well corresponding
lines.plainText: That have a sharper known well corresponding

lines.text: With your stiff age. But unto us it is
lines.plainText: With your stiff age But unto us it is

lines.text: A cell of ignorance, travelling abed,
lines.plainText: A cell of ignorance travelling abed

lines.text: A prison for a debtor that not dares
lines.plainText: A prison for a debtor that not dares

lines.text: To stride a limit.
lines.plainText: To stride a limit

lines.text: What should we speak of
lines.plainText: What should we speak of

lines.text: When we are old as you? When we shall hear
lines.plainText: When we are old as you When we shall hear

lines.text: The rain and wind beat dark December, how,
lines.plainText: The rain and wind beat dark December how

lines.text: In this our pinching cave, shall we discourse.
lines.plainText: In this our pinching cave shall we discourse

lines.text: The freezing hours away? We have seen nothing;
lines.plainText: The freezing hours away We have seen nothing

lines.text: We are beastly: subtle as the fox for prey,
lines.plainText: We are beastly subtle as the fox for prey

lines.text: Like warlike as the wolf for what we eat.
lines.plainText: Like warlike as the wolf for what we eat

lines.text: Our valour is to chase what flies; our cage
lines.plainText: Our valour is to chase what flies our cage

lines.text: We make a choir, as doth the prison'd bird,
lines.plainText: We make a choir as doth the prison'd bird

lines.text: And sing our bondage freely.
lines.plainText: And sing our bondage freely

lines.text: How you speak!
lines.plainText: How you speak

lines.text: Did you but know the city's usuries,
lines.plainText: Did you but know the city's usuries

lines.text: And felt them knowingly; the art o' th' court,
lines.plainText: And felt them knowingly the art o' th' court

lines.text: As hard to leave as keep, whose top to climb
lines.plainText: As hard to leave as keep whose top to climb

lines.text: Is certain falling, or so slipp'ry that
lines.plainText: Is certain falling or so slipp'ry that

lines.text: The fear's as bad as falling; the toil o' th' war,
lines.plainText: The fear's as bad as falling the toil o' th' war

lines.text: A pain that only seems to seek out danger
lines.plainText: A pain that only seems to seek out danger

lines.text: I' th' name of fame and honour, which dies i' th' search,
lines.plainText: I' th' name of fame and honour which dies i' th' search

lines.text: And hath as oft a sland'rous epitaph
lines.plainText: And hath as oft a sland'rous epitaph

lines.text: As record of fair act; nay, many times,
lines.plainText: As record of fair act nay many times

lines.text: Doth ill deserve by doing well; what's worse,
lines.plainText: Doth ill deserve by doing well what's worse

lines.text: Must curtsy at the censure. O, boys, this story
lines.plainText: Must curtsy at the censure O boys this story

lines.text: The world may read in me; my body's mark'd
lines.plainText: The world may read in me my body's mark'd

lines.text: With Roman swords, and my report was once
lines.plainText: With Roman swords and my report was once

lines.text: First with the best of note. Cymbeline lov'd me;
lines.plainText: First with the best of note Cymbeline lov'd me

lines.text: And when a soldier was the theme, my name
lines.plainText: And when a soldier was the theme my name

lines.text: Was not far off. Then was I as a tree
lines.plainText: Was not far off Then was I as a tree

lines.text: Whose boughs did bend with fruit. But in one night
lines.plainText: Whose boughs did bend with fruit But in one night

lines.text: A storm, or robbery, call it what you will,
lines.plainText: A storm or robbery call it what you will

lines.text: Shook down my mellow hangings, nay, my leaves,
lines.plainText: Shook down my mellow hangings nay my leaves

lines.text: And left me bare to weather.
lines.plainText: And left me bare to weather

lines.text: Uncertain favour!
lines.plainText: Uncertain favour

lines.text: My fault being nothing, as I have told you oft,
lines.plainText: My fault being nothing as I have told you oft

lines.text: But that two villains, whose false oaths prevail'd
lines.plainText: But that two villains whose false oaths prevail'd

lines.text: Before my perfect honour, swore to Cymbeline
lines.plainText: Before my perfect honour swore to Cymbeline

lines.text: I was confederate with the Romans. So
lines.plainText: I was confederate with the Romans So

lines.text: Follow'd my banishment, and this twenty years
lines.plainText: Follow'd my banishment and this twenty years

lines.text: This rock and these demesnes have been my world,
lines.plainText: This rock and these demesnes have been my world

lines.text: Where I have liv'd at honest freedom, paid
lines.plainText: Where I have liv'd at honest freedom paid

lines.text: More pious debts to heaven than in all
lines.plainText: More pious debts to heaven than in all

lines.text: The fore-end of my time. But up to th' mountains!
lines.plainText: The foreend of my time But up to th' mountains

lines.text: This is not hunters' language. He that strikes
lines.plainText: This is not hunters' language He that strikes

lines.text: The venison first shall be the lord o' th' feast;
lines.plainText: The venison first shall be the lord o' th' feast

lines.text: To him the other two shall minister;
lines.plainText: To him the other two shall minister

lines.text: And we will fear no poison, which attends
lines.plainText: And we will fear no poison which attends

lines.text: In place of greater state. I'll meet you in the valleys.
lines.plainText: In place of greater state I'll meet you in the valleys
